Ier. 32. vers. 17. 18. 19. Domine, Domine, ecce tu fecisti cælos, & terram virtute tuâ maximâ, & brachio extento: non potest occultari tibi res vlla. Exerces benignitatem in millesimos, & rependis iniquitatem patrum in sinum filiorum ipsorum post ipsos. Deus iste fortis, maximus, potentissimus, cuius nomen est Iehoua exercituum. Magnus es consilio & amplus actione: cum oculi tui aperti spectent in omnes vias hominum, vt des vnicuique secundum vias ipsius, & secundum fructum actionum ipsius. 30 35

page.notes: Scan is a black-and-white photocopy with some faint show-through; the Hebrew-free page contains no Greek or Hebrew. Verse-number marks 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 in the left margin are line numbers, not printed notes, and are transcribed only as inline markers where they fall; the line-number glyphs are marginal and may be inaccurate. Printed "Iehoua" and "Ier. 32" reproduced as printed. "Ion. 1" and "Iacob. 1" are likely Johannes and Iacobus references as printed. Reference mark in the margin next to "Iacob." uncertain. Text beginning "Is (pater luminum)" in the Iacob. entry has the parenthesis as printed; "Is" may be a printer's form and is left as printed. Some words in the Ier. 32 entry, notably "vnicuique" and "post", are slightly blurred.
